shots.title: Route roadmap validation drift warnings into briefing, roadmap show, and sprint start (#453)
shots.notes: Added shared roadmap reality helpers and routed existing scorecard/shipped/phantom drift warnings into slope briefing, slope roadmap show, and slope sprint start. Sprint start now blocks already-scorecarded or already-shipped sprints unless --force is used.

shots.title: Surface sibling worktree dirty/ahead/migration state before sprint selection (#452)

hazards.description: The new worktree status command surfaced an existing stale sibling worktree on feat/workflow-engine with overlapping src/cli files; it validated the feature and did not require changing that worktree.

shots.notes: Added sibling worktree reality collection with ahead/behind counts, dirty files, ahead files, migration detection, touched-path overlap detection, slope worktree status/list, and pre-sprint overlap blocking when --touches is supplied. Sprint start also auto-claims the sprint area for the current player when the store is available.

shots.title: Add regression coverage for pre-sprint reality checks

hazards.description: The new worktree status regression caught that Git porcelain output was being trimmed before fixed-column parsing, turning src/api.ts into rc/api.ts; the parser now preserves leading status columns.

shots.notes: Added CLI regressions for roadmap show drift output, briefing drift output, sprint start blocking an already-scorecarded sprint, and worktree status overlap/migration output. Full pnpm test passed after the parser fix.

conditions: Implemented with a known sibling worktree overlap surfaced by the new command after the branch was already in flight.

training.description: Git porcelain status output must preserve leading columns until after status parsing.
training.outcome: S124 changed the shared git helper to trim only trailing whitespace and parse status paths from the fixed-width porcelain columns.

training.description: Pre-sprint checks are most useful when wired into both passive briefing surfaces and active start gates.
training.outcome: Roadmap drift is visible in briefing and roadmap show, while sprint start blocks already-complete/scorecarded sprint selections.

training.description: Sibling worktree conflict reporting should be actionable without being noisy.
training.outcome: The worktree surface excludes ignored state/build paths, summarizes long file lists, and only blocks when explicit --touches overlap is detected.

nutrition.description: pnpm typecheck, focused Vitest coverage, pnpm build, full pnpm test, roadmap validation, and whitespace checks passed.
slope worktree status now exposes the same sibling-worktree hazard class requested in #452.
A stale feat/workflow-engine sibling worktree still exists with overlapping src/cli changes and should be cleaned up separately if no longer needed.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Useful in exactly the way this sprint wanted: the tooling now tells the player about stale reality before they step onto the wrong tee.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Use --touches on sprint start when you know the planned files; that is the difference between a heads-up and a hard overlap block.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The regression test found a real porcelain parsing bug immediately, which made the new worktree surface sharper before it shipped.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The next sprint can trust briefing and sprint start to catch more of the drift that previously only appeared after a PR or release.

bunker_locations: Preserve Git porcelain leading columns until after path extraction.
A stale sibling worktree on feat/workflow-engine currently overlaps src/cli files.
Generated CODEBASE.md is ignored, so map refreshes are local verification rather than commit artifacts.

slope worktree status and slope worktree list show sibling worktree ahead/behind, dirty files, ahead files, migrations, and touched-path overlap.
